system.description:
An external source caused you to manifest powers or perhaps the cure for an accident caused it.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Elemental/Energy powers category

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Materials powers category

• Select from Psychic powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.rH74GhehJpAtALYR]{Area Alteration}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.VAUyGwApaTOkHmHe]{Inflict}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.UL1tw6hVedoFeimF]{Reflexive Burst}

Gain one of these Green abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.aPsvIm1EFK1S1ejN]{Ambush Awareness}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.cy9AVkrCByZaSKm1]{Change in Circumstance}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.AzntVIjO1ZqW93Ep]{Immunity}
Archetype

Roll d12, d6 for archetype selection.
